correctness.rationale: All-parameter integral proof: classify acyclic vertex subsets by forbidden triangles and four-cycles; cover by two-part subcomplexes with simplex intersections; compute each pair H2 as the bipartite graph cycle lattice using integral Mayer--Vietoris and explicit tetrahedron-boundary cycles; use the natural Čech cover spectral sequence and nerve K_r to identify H1 and H2 canonically without extensions; track the even parity of swapping two two-element blocks; derive exact characters. Independent union-find, mod-two boundary ranks and signed Lefschetz checks agree on eleven graphs and all 2,238 tested automorphisms. Finite verification is corroborative only.

value.rationale: Unlike the known nonequivariant wedge type, the complete integral automorphism action captures orientation and symmetry information. A uniform canonical lattice formula with every block permutation and exact trace for each automorphism is structurally motivated and not a numeric rank recomputation. The unsigned part-swap tensor flip is a critical non-obvious sign and yields consequences such as no globally invariant positive rational homology for equal-size multipartite graphs. The claim is not stretched to equivariant homotopy classification.
